texts.value: May play a role in anchoring the cytoskeleton to the plasma membrane

Homodimer. Interacts with the syntrophins SNTA1; SNTB1 and SNTB2. Interacts with SYNM. Interacts (via its WWW and ZZ domains) with DAG1 (via the PPXY motif of betaDAG1); the interaction is inhibited by the tyrosine phosphorylation of the PPXY motif of DAG1. Interacts with DTNB (By similarity). Interacts with PGM5 (By similarity)
Isoform 1 has high expression in muscle. Isoforms Up70 and Up140 were found in all the adult and fetal tissues tested and relatively abundant in lung and kidney
Actin binding affinity is primarily determined by CH domain 1
